title: Important Message from Sultan al-Awliya
body:
(dt.: WichtigeBotschaft)
Yaa RijaalAllah! Madad, madad ila sharifeen 'nabiyuna wa `ali wa saahbihi, wa mashaykhina. Madad yaa
Saahibu 'z-Zamaan Muhammad Mahdi (a), wa salaat wa salaam also, wa imdaad also. Alfu salaat, alfu salaam
`ala habeebillah Sayyidi 'l-awwaleen wa' l-akhireen! Allahu Akbar wa ajal wa a`azham wa aqwaa. Subhaanuh
Sultaanuhu wa Mulkuhu, laa yantahi. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'rRaheem. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
As salaamu `alaykum, ayyuha 'n-naas! That is our real honor, that the Lord of Heavens through his honored
servants is calling to His servants by divine protocol. SubhaanAllah, He is calling to Mankind through His
most beloved servant, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) to say and to call to
people, Ayyuha 'n-naas, "O people." Everyone in the Divine Presence He is calling with His endless mercy
and endless granting, ikraam. He, Almighty Allah, (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) is creating and
honoring and addressing His creatures!
O People! Look and understand. If you have a little bit of understanding, you must fall down, to put your
head down (in sajdah) and not to take it up, because the Lord of Heavens, Sultan as-Salaateen, Maalik al-

Mulook, Jalla Jalaaluh (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) is addressing you, and we are running away!
O Mankind! Ptuu (spit) on such people that are not coming to say, “O our Lord!” and falling into sajdah!
There are millions of people on whom the Lord of Heavens is sending His salaams and greetings and honors,
and such creatures are running away! Think on it, O People! Don’t think that they are saying, “This person is
speaking, they need so many subjects.” It is nothing, it is nothing.
O People of Understanding! It is nothing. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Asta`eedhu billah.
•••• •••• ••••• ••••••••• ••••••• • ••••••••••• •••••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••• •••• ••••••• ••••••••• ••••••
Qul law kaana al-bahru midaadan li-kalimaati rabbee la-nafida 'l-bahru qabla an tanfada kalimaatu rabbee.
Say (O Muhammad), "And if the oceans were ink and the trees pens, they would be used up before writing the
Words of our Lord." (Surat al-Kahf, 18:109)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Something else is now granted according to its capacity; Allah Almighty is granting
everything that is suitable for it. The understanding of an ant can’t be the understanding of an elephant.
Therefore, don’t think when Allah Almighty is saying about His Majesty, that bahr, ocean, if we use it for
kalimaatullah, the Divine Speeches (Allah's Word), the Pacific Ocean, Atlantic Ocean, Indian Ocean,
Northern Ocean, Southern Ocean, if we are using them as ink for writing, (don't think) those oceans will ever
finish. The Lord’s (swt) words are never-ending! Bring seventy oceans or seventy-million oceans, or seventybillion oceans! Bring seventy-trillion oceans!
O Mankind! Don’t be proud, as pride is only His Majesty’s Heavenly Attribute. It is a Divine Attribute, not for
you. Subhaan Sen, Subhaan Sen. SubhaanAllah, SubhaanAllah, SultaanAllah. (Mawlana Shaykh
stands) SultaanAllah, SultaanAllah, SultaanAllah. Sultaan ul-Mutlaq. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O People! What are we saying? We are saying nothing! He Almighty is asking only that we keep our real
positions of how we were put here.
O Mankind! Make a medallion and write on it, “We are the Lord’s weak servants.” Make such a thing and put
it on your chest. If you can do that, capital to you! May Allah forgive me. Enough. As-salaamu `alaykum.
(Shaykh Hisham Effendi: Mawlana, they are thanking you a lot that every day you were giving them a speech.)

Thanks to Allah.
(Shaykh Hisham Effendi: Is there any opening, inshaa-Allah, for more speeches?)
What speech?
(Shaykh Hisham Effendi: For tomorrow and after tomorrow?)
As He likes; as His beloved one is giving permission.
(Shaykh Hisham Effendi: Yaa Mawlaana, Hadrat … mentioned the hadith, yaa `abdee ati`anee. Aja`luka
rabbaaniyyan. Sayyidee, rahmatan lil-murideen, Sayyidee, to whom they are asking.)
Those who are asking are small ones. When new inspiration is coming, we may speak.
(Shaykh Hisham Effendi: Inshaa-Allah)
Inshaa-Allah, inshaa-Allah. As-salaamu `alaykum. When new orders are coming, they may make so many of
Allah Almighty’s countless servants speak. It is not needed that only I am speaking, making a speech. He may
send and He may be giving His orders and salutes and honors to Mankind. May Allah forgive me. It is a short
time from today up to the end of the world. They may bring someone to speak. It is not a condition that this
one may speak or that one is coming to speak, no. He may leave this closed and open another. We are only
small and weak servants, but I am happy there is an awakening because heavenly words must touch to their
conscience. And I think the real news is, the Last Day is approaching firmly and continuity is for Allah,
everything must pass away.
This dunya’s life that is appointed is just approaching and Judgment Day is coming. There are some signs
that the `ulamas are knowing. Allah Almighty is saying: (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
•••••• ••••••••••• •••••• •••••••••• •••• •••••••••••• ••••••• • •••••• ••••• •••••••••••• •••••••• •••••• ••••• •••••••••••
•••••••••••
fahal yanzhuroona illa as-saa`ata an taatiyahum baghtatan faqad jaa ashraa•uhaa fa annaa lahum idhaa
jaathum dhikraahum. Do they then await (anything) other than the Hour, that it should come upon them

suddenly? But some of its Signs have already come, and when it (actually) is on them, how can they benefit
then by their reminder? (Muhammad 47:18)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Fifteen centuries ago Allah Almighty was saying that the Last Day’s Signs just began.
Fifteen centuries ago! Therefore, a little bit, people must give some time for their Eternal lives. May Allah
forgive us. When it is necessary, the Lord of Heavens is sending His servants to address you and make you
wake up!
O People! They are asking you only to take a little bit of care for your Lord’s servanthood. It may be this world
can be a paradise if people are following their Lord’s commands; if not, troubles and problems, balaa,
affliction, are endlessly and always running on them. It may be that at one time or another something is sent
to people for thinking on it.
And you pray for me also. I am weak and He knows; the Lord of Heavens is knowing everything. I am asking
forgiveness from my Lord, Almighty Allah, (Mawlana Shaykh stands) and the intercession of His holiest one,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) I am asking support from awliyaaullah, from holy people. I
am weak now. As they are saying, Allah Almighty may send to His servants hundreds of thousands of
warners. Shaykh Hisham Effendi is saying to me that when my declarations stopped, there came a shock on
people. No, “Who is asking, they shall find.”
O People! If you are looking and listening, you can find everything much more. Collect yourself, take yourself
a little bit from the dunya, and try to give much more time for the Lord of Creation. The mercy of the Lord of
Creation is countless! As-salaamu `alaykum.
(Shaykh Hisham Effendi: wa salaamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh, Sayyidee.This is a very, very
strong message, Sayyidee.)
Because they are saying I am only a naaqil, transferring one, nothing else, and I am a little bit weak, so I was
asking for a little bit of support, and we can continue inshaa-Allah.
(Shaykh Hisham Effendi: Inshaa-Allah, Sayyidee.)

Fatihah.
(Shaykh Hisham Effendi: Sayyidee, long life, support by Prophet (s), by Mahdi (a), by Allah (swt), y`uteek,
yaa Sayyidee. Allah ya`teek quwwa wa yuqawwiy rijlayk.)
Allah, Allah. Dastoor, yaa Rijaalullah, madad. Madad, yaa Rijaalullah, madad. Ila sharafin nabiyyin …
